algorithm.review_slice: sha256(sorted(slice_id + NUL + repo-relative path + NUL + slice bytes + NUL))
algorithm.legacy_whole_file: sha256(sorted(repo-relative path + NUL + file bytes + NUL))

gate_sha_contract.pending_rule: pending rows MUST leave approved_content_sha empty
gate_sha_contract.approval_rule: after the exact human phrase, approved_content_sha MUST copy the current expected_content_sha verbatim and receipt MUST copy bundle_mode + slice_manifest_sha; never use raw file sha256
